name: Xometry
old_description: We are the manufacturer of record and stand behind the outcome, de-risking your operation.
about:
Xometry operates from Lexington, Kentucky, where it was founded in 2013 with a mission to make the world's manufacturing capacity accessible to all. The company went public in June 2021 and has since grown to a global team of over 1,500 employees.

The company runs an AI-driven digital marketplace that connects buyers to a vetted network of more than 5,000 manufacturing suppliers. Through its instant-quoting engine, Xometry offers CNC machining (3-, 4-, and 5-axis milling, turning, drilling, and wire EDM), a full suite of 3D printing technologies (FDM, HP Multi Jet Fusion, SLS, SLA, PolyJet, Carbon DLS, DMLS, and metal binder jetting), sheet and tube fabrication (laser cutting, waterjet, bending, and tube laser cutting), injection molding, urethane and silicone casting, plastic extrusion, die casting, metal stamping, metal extrusion, welding, and assembly. The platform has shipped over 165 million parts to 90,000 active buyers worldwide.

Xometry serves Fortune 500 companies in aerospace and defense, automotive, and medical sectors, as well as space exploration and electric-vehicle programs. Documented customer projects include helping SentriLock overcome supply-chain disruption, scaling critical components for an electric motorcycle maker, delivering precision parts for Intuitive Machines' lunar mission, supporting Sea Box on a major defense project, and contributing to the Elettra 2.0 light-source upgrade.

Xometry differentiates itself by acting as the manufacturer of record, standing behind every part's outcome. Its AI-powered quoting engine delivers instant prices with no minimum order quantities, free standard U.S. shipping, and integrated digital workflows that provide traceability and transparency from order to delivery. The company holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, AS9100D, IATF 16949:2016, ITAR registration, and CMMC Level 2 certification.
